html:
The Compact of Free Association took effect in 1986, ending US trusteeship over the Marshall Islands and making them a sovereign state, freely associated with the United States.

The US provides money, defence and services, and keeps the use of the Kwajalein missile range. Marshallese can live and work in the US without visas, and many have moved to Arkansas, Hawaii and elsewhere.

The deal included a fund for victims of nuclear testing, which islanders say has been far too small. The Federated States of Micronesia and Palau signed similar compacts. See also Runit Dome.
sum: The Compact of Free Association took effect in 1986, ending US trusteeship over the Marshall Islands and making them a sovereign state, freely associated with the United States.
